briefing.headline: OpenAI deploys o4 with native multi-agent orchestration amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as frontier labs push multi-agent systems into production. Funding surges past $11B this quarter while safety gaps widen in deployed models.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with native orchestration; Anthropic's Claude 4.1 and Google's Gemini 3.0 follow closely. DeepSeek-V3 undercuts pricing while xAI scales Colossus to 1M H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units; Microsoft and Google announce new 200MW data centers in Texas and Arizona. TSMC allocates 40% capacity to AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory capture or technical breakthroughs determine the winner of the 2027 AGI threshold?
